raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Bottom-right load direction",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The prose specifies the load location but not its direction; no load arrow is legible in the supplied figure.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical transverse force, proportional to (0, -1).",
        "Horizontal axial force, proportional to (1, 0)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 4.1 and Fig. 10 caption specify bottom-right loading without vector components; supplied Fig. 6."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Bottom-right load footprint",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Corner loading is described without specifying whether it is concentrated at one node or distributed over a short boundary segment.",
      "readings": [
        "A concentrated force on the bottom-right corner node.",
        "Uniform traction over the lowest right-edge element, of length 0.01 in domain units, with the same total resultant."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Secs. 4.1–4.2 describe loading at the bottom-right corner; no footprint or nodal weighting is given for this case. Table 1 specifies a 200 by 100 mesh."
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Total applied force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No force magnitude is specified. It scales unnormalized compliance and cancels in the solid-normalized compliance.",
      "readings": [
        "Total resultant force of 1 N.",
        "Total resultant force of 1000 N."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only",
      "evidence": "Secs. 3.1 and 4.1 provide no numerical force magnitude; Sec. 3.1 defines c = C/C_solid."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson ratio",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Two different Poisson ratios are assigned to the numerical examples.",
      "readings": [
        "Poisson ratio nu = 1/3.",
        "Poisson ratio nu = 0.3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.3 states nu = 1/3 for the numerical examples; Appendix A states nu = 0.3 for all experiments."
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional elastic constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The two-dimensional elasticity model is not identified as plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress.",
        "Plane strain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Sec. 3.1 specifies square first-order elements and linear elasticity in Eq. (4); Appendix A gives E and nu without specifying the plane assumption."
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter radius R/h",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "The tabulated radius conflicts with the radius–projection relations stated for all examples when beta = 10.",
      "readings": [
        "R/h = 25, following Table 1 and retaining beta = 10.",
        "R/h = 30, following beta = R/(3h) with beta = 10.",
        "R/h = 50, following beta = R/(5h) with beta = 10."
      ],
      "effect": "layout",
      "evidence": "Table 1 gives R = 25 element widths for Sec. 4.1; Appendix A states beta = 10 and beta = R/(3h) or R/(5h)."
    }
  ]
}
